```sql
WITH snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(from_date) AS as_of_date 
    FROM salaries
), ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.birth_date, d.as_of_date) AS age, 
        e.gender, 
        s.salary, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.birth_date, d.as_of_date), e.gender ORDER BY s.salary, e.emp_no) AS rn, 
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.birth_date, d.as_of_date), e.gender) AS n 
    FROM employees e 
    JOIN salaries s ON s.emp_no = e.emp_no 
    CROSS JOIN snapshot d 
    WHERE s.from_date <= d.as_of_date AND s.to_date > d.as_of_date
)
SELECT 
    age, 
    gender, 
    AVG(salary) AS median_salary, 
    MAX(n) AS employee_count, 
    (SELECT as_of_date FROM snapshot) AS as_of_date 
FROM ranked 
WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((n + 1) / 2), FLOOR((n + 2) / 2)) 
GROUP BY age, gender 
ORDER BY age, gender;
```
